text: @valuz/dsh-valuz-genui 是面向 DSH Web 的生成式界面插件，为模型注册 generate_ui 工具并提供 A2UI 编写指南。模型可直接生成图表、指标卡、表格、表单或仪表盘文档，工具校验后由聊天客户端将其作为交互式界面流式呈现，用户操作也会回传给模型。它不额外发起模型请求，也不写入文件；适合希望在对话中查看和操作模型生成数据视图的 DSH 用户。默认使用会话当前模型，无需额外密钥，可设置文档大小上限和指南展示方式。

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui adds generate_ui to DSH Web. The model authors A2UI charts, tables, forms, or dashboards, rendered as interactive chat surfaces while generating. User actions return to the model. The tool validates documents and uses the session model; no extra API key is needed.
想让 DSH 在聊天里直接生成可交互的图表。
能不能把数据做成对话中的仪表盘？
我想在聊天回复里查看可以操作的表格和表单。
让模型把回答整理成指标卡片并展示在页面里。
DSH 能否边生成内容边呈现界面？
我希望点选生成界面里的控件后，模型能收到我的操作。
I want the assistant to show an interactive dashboard inside the chat.
Can a chat answer include a live chart or table I can interact with?
@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui 的功能「生成交互式界面」：模型调用 generate_ui 提交 A2UI 消息，工具校验文档后返回界面元数据，聊天窗口将图表、表格、表单等内容作为交互面板呈现。
@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui 的功能「生成期间预览」：模型流式输出 generate_ui 参数时，客户端逐步提取完整消息并更新会话节点，让用户在工具调用结束前看到已完成的界面内容。
@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui 的功能「交互回传」：用户触发表面中的控件后，客户端将动作名、组件和上下文封装为消息并发送到当前会话，使模型可以根据操作继续回应或更新界面。
@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui 的功能「文档验证与限制」：generate_ui 接收 A2UI 消息数组，检查消息结构、序列化字节数和组件文档有效性；超过配置上限或无法渲染时会报错。
@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui 的功能「完成回放展示」：工具将规范化文档和组件信息保存在结果元数据中，客户端在调用完成后以权威文档呈现，并在回合结束后把界面放到消息末尾。

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · dsh-valuz-genui：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives the model a `generate_ui` tool: the **model itself authors** an [A2UI](https://a2ui.org) v0.9.1 document and passes it to `generate_ui`, and the browser renders it as an **interactive surface inline in the chat** — charts, KPI cards, tables, forms, dashboards — **streaming as the model writes the call**, and whose interactions come back to the model.

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · dsh-valuz-genui：There is **no nested model call**: the UI is the model's own streamed output, so it appears live (like a fenced block), costs one model turn, and can't fail with a mid-stream error from a second request. It builds on the provider-agnostic [valuz-genui](https://github.com/valuz-ai/valuz-genui) core (76-component A2UI catalog, streaming sanitizer, React renderer).

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · Compatibility：| Plugin | DeepSeek Harness |
|---|---|
| 0.2.x | 0.2.x (from 0.2.0-rc.2) |
| 0.1.x | 0.1.0-rc.6 to 0.1.1 |

dsh 0.2 replaced the client Conversation APIs that 0.1.x uses, so 0.1.x fails to load there with `pending (waiting for service: conversationEvents)`. dsh checks a plugin's declared peer ranges at install and startup, so an incompatible pairing is refused before it loads.

Into an existing profile that already has a model configured:

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · Compatibility：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @valuz/dsh-valuz-genui
```

The npm package ships a prebuilt `lib/`, so no build step or `allowBuilds` entry is needed. To pin an unreleased commit instead, install from git — pnpm ≥ 10 then blocks the git dependency's `prepare` build until you allow it; the first `add` fails and prints the exact key to copy into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:valuz-ai/dsh-valuz-genui#<commit-sha>
```

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · Compatibility：```yaml
allowBuilds:
  '@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui@https://codeload.github.com/valuz-ai/dsh-valuz-genui/tar.gz/<commit-sha>': true
```

Then restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh. Ask the model for a chart or dashboard to verify. **No extra configuration is needed** — the model authors the UI through whatever model the session is using.

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · Local development：The generation core and renderer come from npm (`@valuz/genui-core`, `@valuz/a2ui`, from [valuz-ai/valuz-genui](https://github.com/valuz-ai/valuz-genui)); the client bundle inlines them at build time:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/valuz-ai/dsh-valuz-genui.git
cd dsh-valuz-genui && pnpm install && pnpm run check

text: @valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · The tool：The tool validates the document, pins the catalog id, drops schema-invalid components (siblings survive), and persists everything to `tool/result.meta`. The model receives a one-line receipt.

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · Configuration：Override the `valuz-genui` row by id in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxDocumentBytes` | 262144 | Inclusive byte cap on the serialized A2UI document. |
| `alwaysOnFullGuide` | false | Keep the full field-signature catalog in the system prompt instead of the on-demand `genui` skill. |

@valuz/dsh-valuz-genui README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Placement inside completed turns.** dsh folds a completed turn's process (skill load, reasoning, tool calls) into a collapsed "Completed in Ns" disclosure. The plugin therefore shows a completed turn's settled surfaces at the end of the turn, after the final reply, through dsh's `conversation.chat.turnTail` slot, and replaces each surface inside the process with a one-line reference. A later surface with the same title counts as a revision, so only the latest one appears at the turn's end; surfaces with different titles all appear. A surface that never settled (for example, an interrupted call) stays inside the process.
- **Always-on prompt cost.** Where the host supports skills (`ctx.skills`, e.g. the web profile), only a compact guide (~3.1k tokens: component names + one-line purposes + the message contract) stays always on, and the full field-signature catalog (~9k tokens) loads on demand through the `genui` skill.
